other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Puducherry by birth or have continuous residence of at least five years
The submitted text must be printed and published as a first edition by 31 December of the specified year
A one‑time awardee is ineligible to apply for the next four years
Submissions must not be abridgments, adaptations, translations, or paraphrases of another text
Essays or theses submitted for a university degree or examination are not eligible
Texts written for school syllabi are not accepted
Children’s literature must be published in Tamil and must not exceed 120 pages
Foundation lectures, other lectures, serials in journals, etc., are not accepted
Eligible categories include novels, short stories, poems, plays, travelogues, collections of essays, and similar works for children’s literature
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹10,000 and a certificate.
